basis: 2014 is the already-governed first selection origin in the frozen Forecast redevelopment, so retaining it avoids choosing a new start year after viewing later outcomes.
At origin 2014, exact rolling training already contains 7 source seasons for Y2 (2005-2011) and 6 for Y3 (2005-2010).
All four positions have hundreds of training rows and hundreds of active target rows by origin 2014.
sensitivity_rule: May be reported only as sensitivity after the primary 2014-start design is frozen; they cannot replace the primary design based on candidate results.
calendar_timestamp_note: The governed model coordinate is season-boundary point-in-time, not a persisted daily forecast timestamp.
